name: agent-bridge
description: Controller tools for multi-harness work: delegate bounded tasks to DeepSeek Harness workers (dsh_project bridge_* tools) and consult, cross-review or appoint the other harness as sub-controller (agent_peer peer_* tools), with one root controller per task and no delegation loops.

node_path.title: Node.js 24 executable
node_path.description: Absolute path of node.exe (Node 24 or later) used to run the bridge carrier and the peer server. Use plain 'node' only if it is on PATH for Claude Code.

dsh_bridge_url.title: DSH bridge endpoint
dsh_bridge_url.description: HTTP endpoint the DSH host mounts for the bridge.

dsh_credential_file.title: Bridge credential file
dsh_credential_file.description: File holding the bridge bearer token. Leave empty to use DSH_MCP_TOKEN from the environment or the default $DSH_HOME/codex-bridge-v1/bridge-token.

peer_config.title: agent-peer config
peer_config.description: Absolute path of the agent-peer JSON config (peer CLI executables, state directory, limits). Shared with the Codex side so both see the same job ledger.
